title: American Heart Association testifies against soft-drink removal in the Texas Senate

tellings.quote: And the American Heart Association, this is the world we live in now, the American Heart Association showed up to testify against us at the original one.

plain: A guest on Jesse Michels' podcast, Brigham Buhler, says that in the 2020s he took part in an effort in the Texas Senate in Austin to remove soft drinks from some program. He says that at the first hearing the American Heart Association, a large US health charity focused on heart disease, came to testify against his side. He tells it as a sign of how upside down he thinks the health world has become.
